Categories: Imagination Technologies, IP

Key takeaways ▼

The rapid growth of AI at the edge is forcing SoC architects to rethink traditional processor designs. Dedicated NPUs deliver impressive performance for today’s models, but evolving AI workloads, increasing system complexity and growing pressure on power and silicon budgets are exposing the limitations of fixed-function approaches.
Register Now
In this webinar, a product expert from Imagination will explore a new approach to acceleration: a converged architecture that brings graphics, compute and AI together on a single processor and software stack. You’ll learn why leading-edge system designers are looking beyond standalone accelerators, how data movement and memory bandwidth are becoming critical bottlenecks, and what architectural choices can help deliver both flexibility and efficiency in future edge devices.
The session will also examine the growing role of GPUs in AI acceleration, including support for emerging workloads such as generative AI and neural rendering, while maintaining the graphics performance users expect. Whether you’re designing for automotive, consumer, industrial or embedded systems, you’ll gain practical insights into the trends shaping next-generation edge computing architectures.
Register Now to discover how converged acceleration could simplify system design, improve resource utilization and help future-proof your next SoC.
Key takeaways
Attendees will learn:

Why current edge AI systems are set to shift toward converged acceleration.
How graphics, compute and AI workloads can coexist on a common processor architecture.
The impact of memory bandwidth and data movement on AI system efficiency.
Why programmability is becoming increasingly important as AI models continue to evolve.
Key considerations for architects building next-generation edge and embedded systems.

Overview

What’s unique about our designs is that they’re high-performance and power efficient, while being squeezed into the smallest space possible. That means a no-compromise approach to making your gadgets smart and portable. It’s this philosophy that has led to Imagination powering more than 13 billion of the world’s most iconic electronic devices; from phones to drones.

They use the best tools and latest resources to solve some of technology’s most complex challenges for our customers, giving them a competitive edge and putting Imagination at the heart of the most important trends in technology.
